description: A remote attestation proof record holding the CID of attested content. Lives in the attestor's repository and is referenced from the attested record's `signatures` array via `com.atproto.repo.strongRef`. Conforms to the ATProtocol Attestation Specification.

main.description: Remote attestation proof containing the CID of the content being attested.

cid.description: CID of the attested content, computed per the ATProtocol Attestation Specification: encode the attested record with its `signatures` field removed and a temporary `$sig` object inserted as canonical DAG-CBOR, then SHA-256 hash to produce a 36-byte CIDv1. `$sig` is this proof record without its `cid` field (so `$type`, plus `note` and `createdAt` when set), plus `repository`: the DID of the repository that holds the attested record.

note.description: Optional note explaining the attestation purpose or context.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this proof was created.
